label: Explicitly non-held-out diagnostic of existing ordinary routes; corpus and gold already inspected
purpose: Check current context-retaining route for source-preservation cautions without modifying original frozen comparison

shared_configuration.security_filter: ULVR-London-ordinary-unresolved; retrieval may report unresolved identity, never assert verified listing/order eligibility
shared_configuration.truncation: Do not truncate within a passage or table row; omit a whole excess record and record exclusion reason.
shared_configuration.prompt_reason: Deterministic retrieval only; no model prompt exists.

sole_selection_difference: Use existing ordinary build_packet balance=True (pre-existing default) for both direct-file and FTS routes, rather than frozen comparison balance=False. No code, query, source, gold, cutoff or packet-limit change.
checks: Original five gold exact passages, scored after packets are created; evaluator metadata not used for selection
Original six historical negative controls remain excluded
Selected records, packet hashes, bytes, exclusions and deterministic index rebuild equality
stopping_rule: Run once; preserve any failure; no outcome-driven retry, cap increase, query/source/gold change or acceptance-status promotion
limitations: Does not change original4/5 result or create a new held-out result.
No investment conclusion, edge, savings or generic recall-performance claim.
Partial issuer source preservation remains an actual evidential limitation.
